label: Full-frame promo loop
description: 1920x1080 promo takeover: subject cutout over the surface colour, kicker chip, headline, one to three price tiers, CTA and the terms line. Renders as an overlay inside the menu-board loop, or on its own as a promo-only video.

hero.note: Uses the matted PNG from the image pipeline, scaled to fit and drop-shadowed. Falls back to the flat frame when matting was unavailable.

notes: Offsets are relative to the moment the overlay fades in; the compiler turns them into absolute times.
The overlay always fades back to opacity 0 before the loop restarts, so the last frame equals frame 0.
